meta.title: Vietnam Itinerary 10 Days Hanoi, Danang, Hoi An, Phu Quoc, Ho Chi Minh North to south Vietnam Tour
meta.description:
#vietnam #hanoi #phuquoc 
Vietnam Itinerary 10 days - 8 Cities Tour North to South of Vietnam
Hanoi - 4 Days (with Halong Bay & Ninh Binh)
Danang - 3 Days with Hoi An & Hue City
Phu Quoc Islands - 2 Days
Ho Chi Minh - 2 Days
****Official Govt Evisa Link to apply**** - https://evisa.gov.vn/
*******Direct Flight to Hanoi by Vietjet from India*****
After exchanging money at Hanoi airport, check into a hotel in Hanoi's old quarters.
******My HOTELS LIST ********- 
Click below to know about the hotels I booked through this app
Book this HANOI OLD QUARTER 5 Star hotel - https://tripadvisor.tpk.ro/PCp9sje1  
DANANG BEACH Resort stay - https://tripadvisor.tpk.ro/1HUCYrr3
PHU QUOC DUONG DONG RESORT - https://tripadvisor.tpk.ro/VvmyM59V
HO CHI MINH CITY
**********************************************************************
FOOD TIPS 
For Vietnamese Vegetarian Food, search for the Met Vietnamese chain of restaurants. They have vegetarian fried rice, many vegetarian curries, vegetarian noodles, and many more vegetarian options. 
Must-Try Drinks:
 ☕ Coconut Cream Vietnamese Coffee
 🥭 Passion Fruit Juice
 ☕ Condensed Milk Vietnamese Coffee (Hot or Iced) — rich, sweet, and creamy, an absolute must!
Day 1: Explore Hanoi Old Quarter with the famous train street tour. You arrive late morning, so explore the Old Quarter, Lakeside Temple, the French Quarter & evening nightlife at Famous Train Street with a Vietnamese lunch and an *******Indian Dinner at Indian Masala in the Old Quarter*************.
Day 2: Book a long trip to Halong Bay with lunch and evening snacks/tea. This cruise stops at 4 to 5 places with lots of activities.
Day 3 - Again, book a long day trip to Ninh Binh, which has 3 excellent stops -Hoa Lu: Explore the ancient temples of Dinh King and Le King, the historic capital of Vietnam in the 10th and 11th centuries. Bike across the countryside of Vietnam, and this biking is included in your day trip.
Trang An Grottoes (or Tam Coc): Take a scenic boat tour through a UNESCO World Heritage site, navigating through caves and lush landscapes. 
Mua Caves: Hike up approximately 500 steps to the Ngoa Long mountain viewpoint for impressive panoramic views of Ninh Binh.  Or explore the Lotus garden/pond below.
Day 4: Early morning, explore Hanoi shopping with a great body massage. Fly to Danang via Viet Jet.
If you arrive late in Danang, have dinner at Bhojan Indian restaurant near Danang beach, as our hotel is located there on the beachside. 
Protip: Vietjet gets delayed many times, so keep a margin for the next flight or keep yourself free after that so that some activities don't overlap.
Day 5: Book the Bana Hills full-day Cable ride tour with buffet lunch. An excellent theme park and the longest cable ride in the world, famous in the Guinness World Records. As our Day 4 was wasted in the flight delay, we combined Hoi An on the same day. After Bana Hills, visit Coconut village with a unique rotating basket boat ride across coconut trees in the lagoons. After that, visit Hoi An and do a Lantern boat ride. Hoi is famous as the Lantern City of Vietnam. Explore this city on foot, where you can find amazing lanterns, Vietnamese-style cafes, bars, shopping, silk, tailoring, and much more to do till late at night. Return late to Danang. Our hotel in Danag was on Danag beach.
Day 6: Explore Danang beaches and nearby beaches, and drive to Hue city, approximately 180 km from Danang. In between, you stop at many beautiful spots. Hue City is a historical city with a tomb and a Citadel.
Day 7: Early morning checkout and fly to Phu Quoc Island via Vietnam Airlines. Check into a resort-style island vibes hotel. After that, book a 4-island-hopping speedboat tour with sunset from the boat. You can also watch the sunset with a special show from Sunset Village.
Have an **Indian dinner at Ganesh Indian restaurant*** in the main Duong Dong market. 
Day 8: Visit Grand World - an Italy-style town in Phu Quoc with many colorful streets, shopping, and beaches. Fly on Day 8 to Ho Chi Minh City and check into a hotel at the city centre near Saigon Square late in the evening.
Day 9: Book a half-day trip to cu Chi tunnels to know about the American-Vietnamese War. After having lunch on tour, return and explore the walking markets of Ho Chi Minh City, which are famous for shopping.
Then explore the famous nightlife of Ho Chi Minh City at Bui Vien 
Street for a wild night out. For an *******Indian vegetarian restaurant, have food at the Gujarat Indian restaurant******** at Saiqon Square of Grand Market. 
******************************************
Markets in Ho Chi Minh City
1. Ben Tahn Market
2. Saigon Square
3. Taka underground market
4. Biu Vien walking street for cabaret and bars
Day 10: Fly from Ho Chi Minh City to Mumbai via Vietjet with no stopovers - direct flight to India.
